sentences.text: Navajoceratops was a ceratopsid dinosaur that roamed North America during the late Cretaceous Period.
The species name sullivani honors Robert M. Sullivan, who led the team that found the partial skull holotype — the specimen the species is based on — in 2002.
This dinosaur was informally named in 2016.
Fossils were discovered in the Campanian Hunter Wash Member of the Kirtland Formation in New Mexico.
It belongs to the family Ceratopsidae and the subfamily Chasmosaurinae.
Navajoceratops lived between 83.6 and 72.2 million years ago, specifically during the Campanian stage of the late Cretaceous.
